description: Source code for SAML-related API handlers in Mattermost, including initialization, certificate management, metadata retrieval, and auth data reset.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API handler struct for SAML operations

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object passed to handler functions, containing app, logger, and request info

methods.name: InitSamlLocal
methods.description: Initializes local SAML route for resetting auth data

methods.name: getSamlMetadata
methods.description: Handles retrieval of SAML metadata XML

methods.name: parseSamlCertificateRequest
methods.description: Parses multipart form data for SAML certificate files

methods.name: addSamlPublicCertificate
methods.description: Handles adding a public SAML certificate

methods.name: addSamlPrivateCertificate
methods.description: Handles adding a private SAML certificate

methods.name: addSamlIdpCertificate
methods.description: Handles adding an IdP SAML certificate from metadata or file upload

methods.name: getSamlCertificateStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the SAML certificates

methods.name: getSamlMetadataFromIdp
methods.description: Fetches SAML metadata from an IdP URL

methods.name: resetAuthDataToEmail
methods.description: Resets SAML auth data for users, with options for including deleted users and dry run
